literal: Looking at the sky living world all, king's scepter looking at living subjects.
translation: All the world lives looking to the sky for rain; the subjects live looking to the king's scepter for justice.
modern: உலகத்து உயிர்கள் எல்லாம் மழையை எதிர்பார்த்து வாழ்கின்றன; அதுபோல மக்கள் மன்னனது செங்கோலை எதிர்பார்த்து வாழ்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet draws a parallel between the natural order and the political order. Just as all life on earth depends on the sky for rain to survive, the citizens of a kingdom depend on the king's righteous scepter for justice and security. The word 'kōl' (scepter) symbolizes the ruler's fair administration. Without rain, the world perishes; without a just rule, the society perishes.
